Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) under the IC&SR department for temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IIT Madras Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Executive – HR under the advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt. 206/2026 on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Executive – HR?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Executive – HR position in this current recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BBA, BMS, MBA, MA, MHRM, or any undergraduate degree from a recognized institution. An HR-related certification is an added advantage.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Executive – HR role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IIT Madras Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years for general candidates, and it is relaxable up to 30 years for reserved categories like SC and ST.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 15-10-2026. Applicants must complete submissions before this date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Interested candidates need to apply through the official careers portal of IIT Madras IC&SR.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening and testing followed by a final test or interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php before the specified last date.
